name: High Energy Batteries (India) Limited
about: High Energy Batteries (India) Limited manufactures batteries for use in army, navy, air force, and launch vehicles in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Aerospace, Naval and Power System Batteries; and Lead Acid Batteries. The company offers aircraft, torpedo, missile, and helicopter batteries for defense applications; car and truck batteries; and VRLA batteries and other batteries. It also provides silver zinc batteries and cells, nickel cadmium batteries and cells, and silver chloride magnesium batteries, as well as lead acid batteries for commercial applications. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Chennai, India.
